//models: Groq's limits are per organization AND per model: 200k tokens/day and 8k tokens/minute for each pair. With three keys from three separate organizations that is six independent lanes. Work is routed by task — quality-critical calls prefer the larger model, mechanical ones the smaller — and each list doubles as a fallback chain.
//budget: ~24k tokens per Bengali article and ~31k per English one. Six lanes give 1.2M tokens/day, so a full edition uses roughly a fifth of the allowance and leaves ample room for retries.
//tokens: Every request must fit prompt + reserved output inside the provider's 8k/minute ceiling, so the article text and each batch are sized to leave room for the answer.
//answers: BCS Written answers run 220-320 words. Anything under minAnswerWords is regenerated once with the short draft shown to the model, because a stunted answer is exactly what this rewrite set out to fix.
